name: Strakka Relaxed Cargo Jogger
description: A hybrid between a jogger and a cargo pant — relaxed through the hip, tapered at the ankle, with two side cargo pockets that lay flat when empty. Made from a medium-weight synth-canvas that softens with wash. Popular in Tier 2 because they look decent and carry a lot.
functionality: Four cargo pockets with magnetic snap closures; ankle drawcord adjustment
what_it_says: You need your hands free and your pockets full. Practical in a way that's become its own aesthetic.
worn_by: young adults who move around a lot
story_hooks: The flat cargo pockets are a known spot for small-time street traders to stash product — recognizable to anyone in that world.
A character finds a previous owner's handwritten list in a pocket: items, quantities, a name they shouldn't know.

physical_description.visual_profile: A relaxed silhouette that transitions from generous hip volume to a tapered ankle, creating a modern hybrid aesthetic that balances streetwear comfort with practical utility. Reads as simultaneously casual and intentional.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed through hip and thigh with a pronounced taper toward the ankle; sits at natural waist with slight drop crotch; allows freedom of movement without baggy excess
physical_description.primary_material: Medium-weight synth-canvas; durable polymer-cotton blend with a soft hand-feel that improves with repeated washing
physical_description.texture: Smooth surface with subtle directional weave; develops a broken-in patina over time; cargo panels have slight structural rigidity when unworn
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep charcoal-gray base with muted sage-green or rust-orange contrast stitching on seams and pocket details; optional reflective trim at ankle cuffs
physical_description.closures: Single magnetic snap fly closure with friction-fit waistband; reinforced bartack at stress points
distinctive_features: Two angled side cargo pockets designed to lay completely flat when empty
Internal phone pocket on right thigh with RFID-blocking mesh lining
Tapered ankle cuffs with adjustable friction cinch system
Strakka woven label at back waistband in matte gunmetal finish
Reinforced triple-stitched seams at crotch and calf
Subtle 3M reflective piping along outer seams for low-light visibility
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 luxury-functional; expensive enough to signal disposable income, practical enough to wear daily without pretension
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by mid-level corpo workers, independent contractors, and affluent street merchants; signals someone who values both aesthetics and utility without needing to prove either
physical_description.condition_typical: Typically worn in pristine or gently broken-in condition; develops subtle fading at knees and thighs with extended use; patina is considered a selling point
